name: sharedid-edge-workspace
description: SharedID Edge: a first-party edge worker that keeps the Prebid SharedID cookie durable

scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core -w packages/ip-ranges -w packages/adapters -w packages/modules -w conformance --if-present
scripts.attw: npm run attw -w packages/core -w packages/ip-ranges -w packages/adapters -w packages/modules --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:projects && npm run check:links && npm run check:docs && npm run check:duplication && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:ts7 && npm run typecheck:cloudflare && npm run types:check -w @sharedid-edge/cloudflare && npm test && npm run conformance && npm run consumer-types && npm run attw && npm run conformance:lambda && npm run conformance:vercel && npm run conformance:azure && npm run conformance:gcp && npm run conformance:akamai
scripts.conformance:lambda: npm run bundle -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda && npm run bundle:bowser -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda -- --outdir deploy-bowser && npm run bundle -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda -- --outdir deploy-vendor --vendor-modules && npm run conformance:lambda -w @sharedid-edge/conformance
scripts.conformance:lambda-aws-emulator: npm run bundle -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda && npm run bundle:bowser -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda -- --outdir deploy-bowser && npm run bundle -w @sharedid-edge/aws-lambda -- --outdir deploy-vendor --vendor-modules && npm run conformance:lambda-aws-emulator -w @sharedid-edge/conformance

scripts.conformance:gcp: npm run bundle -w @sharedid-edge/gcp-functions && npm run bundle:bowser -w @sharedid-edge/gcp-functions -- --outdir deploy-bowser && npm run bundle -w @sharedid-edge/gcp-functions -- --outdir deploy-vendor --vendor-modules && npm run conformance:gcp -w @sharedid-edge/conformance
